about: Frozen settings of benchmark 2. Every value here is part of the pre-registration: tools/bench2_prereg.py hashes this file. See docs/benchmark2/PROTOCOL.md.
model_notes: No thinking, sampling or fallbacks parameter is sent. Leaving out fallbacks is deliberate: a fallback would put one arm on another model.
system_common: You are checking a company before a business pays it for the first time. {arm_sentence} Answer the three questions about the company as it is today. If your sources do not establish a field, answer unknown or null; do not guess. Today is {today}.

arm_sentence.web: You have web search and web fetch, and nothing else.
arm_sentence.api: You have the result of one call to counterparty-check, a data tool that reads official registers and sanctions lists; it is printed below the question, and you have nothing else.
arm_sentence.memory: You have no tools and no documents, only what you already know.

answer_format: End your answer with one JSON object on its own line: {"status": "active|winding_up|dissolved|unknown", "insolvent": true|false|null, "sanctioned": true|false|null, "sanctions_lists": ["UK"|"OFAC SDN"|"EU", ...]}
client_tool_error: No such tool here. Use web_search or web_fetch, or give your final answer.

fields.status: active = registered and not being wound up; winding_up = still on the register but in liquidation, administration or bankruptcy (solvent or not); dissolved = removed from the register (struck off, deleted, dissolved)
fields.sanctioned: the company itself is listed on the UK Sanctions List, the OFAC SDN List or the EU consolidated financial sanctions list
fields.insolvent: formal insolvency proceedings were opened (bankruptcy, compulsory or creditors' liquidation, administration), now or before dissolution; a members' (solvent) voluntary liquidation or a strike-off is not insolvency

ee_licence_confirmed.note: Estonia is drawn only when this holds the date on which the owner read the licence dialog on avaandmed.ariregister.rik.ee and confirmed CC BY 4.0 (actors/company-check/LEGAL.md). Empty = Estonia is left out.
ee_licence_confirmed.source: https://avaandmed.ariregister.rik.ee/en (footer 'License information' -> https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; terms at /en/terms-service allow reuse, GDPR applies to personal data)

retry.tool_error_note: A web_search or web_fetch result with one of these error codes (the search service was busy or down) makes the attempt invalid, and it is retried like a network error. Every other tool error code is kept as part of the web arm's result; the analysis's named check 'without runs that had a tool error' leaves those runs out.

estimates_usd_per_run.note: Protocol section 9; replaced by the pilot's means at the freeze.

exclusions.note: Companies excluded after the runs (register facts changed between the two reads, or the hand check disagreed), as a share of the drawn A, B and C companies. Above this share the verdict is 'no difference shown' whatever the intervals say, and the report says why. The named check 'all drawn companies, no exclusions' is always printed.

prices.note: Checked 2026-11-19 on the pricing page: Sonnet 5.5 $2 input, $2.50 5-minute cache write (1.25x), $0.10 cache hits (0.05x input), $10 output per MTok; web search $10 per 1,000 searches; web fetch no extra cost.

rule_arm.note: A fixed table, no model: register is flagged when either register check fails, clear when both pass, else no verdict; review, unverified and a missing check are no verdict.

verdict_sentences.product_ahead: On these companies the model reading counterparty-check reached the right decision more often than the model with web search.
verdict_sentences.web_ahead: On these companies the model with web search reached the right decision more often than the model reading counterparty-check.
verdict_sentences.no_difference: This study shows no difference between the model with web search and the model reading counterparty-check; it cannot separate gaps smaller than about {n} points.

drand.note: Chain hash, genesis and period were written from memory; probe reads /info and freeze refuses when they differ. The bases are mirrors of one beacon, not a second source of randomness.
